item.title: M&S named UK’s top brand for fourth year in a row
item.description: Marks & Spencer has topped the list of the strongest brands in the UK for the fourth year running. The top ten, compiled by YouGov’s BrandIndex tool, shows M&S with an overall index score of 52.7, ahead of Ikea with 45.6. Retailers John Lewis and Boots also made the list, in fourth and ninth place,...

item.title: Sainsbury’s staff receiving above inflation pay rise
item.description: Sainsbury’s is granting its staff a 5% pay rise that it said reflected their “exceptional contribution and our commitment to being a great place to work”.

item.title: Job cuts show Amazon ‘cannot be trusted’, says union
item.description: The GMB has condemned Amazon following yesterday’s announcement that 16,000 roles will be axed globally. The union, which has more than 620,000 members across various industries in the UK, released the statement after the online retailer and media company confirmed the cuts on Wednesday 28 January. item.title: H&M lifts profits despite slower sales growth
item.description: H&M has reported a strong rise in profits in 2025, driven by tighter cost control and better stock management, even as sales growth remained modest across its global estate.

item.title: Co-op appoints former Lidl CEO to board
item.description: The Co-op has appointed former Lidl UK chief executive Ronny Gottschlich to its board as an independent non-executive director.

item.title: Card Factory sales climb despite festive trading hit
item.description: Card Factory said its festive trading performance was hit by a challenging UK consumer backdrop as well as lower footfall across UK shopping destinations.

item.title: Gangs ‘targeting one store after another’ as shoplifting rises 5%
item.description: The British Retail Consortium (BRC) has responded to Office for National Statistics (ONS) data showing an increase in shoplifting offences.

item.title: Asda underpaid 53,000 workers holiday and sick pay, says report
item.description: Asda has promised to repay 53,000 current and former staff members who were found to have been underpaid for holiday and sick pay following its Project Future IT upgrade.

item.title: Co-op to launch 18 stores in the first quarter of 2026
item.description: Co-op is opening 18 stores in the first quarter of 2026, with both new sites and re-opening shops following “transformative investment to enhance the shopping experience in high streets and communities”.

item.title: Four reasons why retailers need to get personal with their returns policy
item.description: ASOS rang in the new year with a change to its returns policy, saying it would eliminate return fees for consumers with a lower return rate, writes Paul Gardner, VP of product at loss prevention consultants Appriss Retail.
